verified_method_scope_summary: A base classifier supplies predicted-label groups; each node samples a donor from its predicted group.
Node copying changes the neighborhood to the donor's observed neighborhood while keeping node features unchanged.
Graph inference depends on observed topology, features and training labels.
The prose and Algorithm 1 train a GCNN over each sampled graph and use MC dropout for its conditional weights.
The printed v1 prediction factors in Eqs. (6)–(7) use G_obs; this differs from BGCN's prediction on sampled G and is preserved as a scope caveat.

Mean member logits teach the fused head; fused head teaches the members; each has CE and all train simultaneously.
